Guideline Note: 
Effective Date: 
11/1/2023  
 
 
 
 
1 .  Criteria 
 
Product Name:Daxxify  
Diagnosis 
Cervical Dystonia  
Approval Length 
3 month(s)  
Therapy Stage 
Initial Authorization  
Guideline Type 
Prior Authorization  
 
 
Approval Criteria    
 
1 - Submission of medical records (e.g., chart notes) documenting a diagnosis of cervical 
dystonia

Page 447 
Product Name:Daxxify  
Diagnosis 
Cervical Dystonia  
Approval Length 
3 month(s)  
Therapy Stage 
Reauthorization  
Guideline Type 
Prior Authorization  
 
 
Approval Criteria    
 
1 - Submission of medical records (e.g., chart notes) documenting positive clinical response 
to therapy  
 
AND 
 
2 - At least 3 months have or will have elapsed since the last treatment  
 
Product Name:Daxxify  
Diagnosis 
Cosmetic Use  
Approval Length 
N/A - requests for cosmetic use are excluded and will not be approved 
Guideline Type 
Prior Authorization  
 
 
Approval Criteria    
 
1 - Requests for coverage of any Daxxify product for treating the appearance of facial lines 
are not authorized and will not be approved. These uses are considered cosmetic only and 
are excluded from coverage.  
Notes  
Requests for coverage of any Daxxify product for treating the appeara
nce of facial lines are not authorized and will not be approved. These 
uses are considered cosmetic only and are excluded from coverage.
